recommendationIntro: Recommended choices describe regular Auto Beri use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

steps.title: Choose your attack and supply source

items.label: Open settings
items.description: On the Automation page, open the Auto Beri World card settings.

items.label: Attack preset
items.description: Choose a saved Berimond attack formation; Auto Beri uses its troop mix for transfers as well as tower attacks.
items.recommendation: Create and select your usual Berimond preset first.

items.label: Source castle
items.description: Choose the Great Empire castle or outpost supplying those troops.
items.recommendation: Select the castle that holds your attack army.

items.label: Horse travel boost
items.description: Choose feather, coin, or ruby travel for tower attacks.
items.recommendation: Travel Feather for fast travel without selecting ruby travel.

items.label: Attack check interval
items.description: Set how often Auto Beri checks for another tower attack.
items.recommendation: Keep the usual 30-second interval unless you need fewer checks.

items.label: Daily normal attack limit
items.description: Stop new Auto Beri tower attacks at the account-wide daily normal-attack count; 0 removes this added limit.
items.recommendation: 0 unless you use an account-wide cap.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Beri choose your attack and supply source settings
image.caption: Saved attack preset, Great Empire donor castle, Travel Feather, attack check, and daily limit.

items.label: Owned Berimond camp
items.description: Auto Beri finds your owned Berimond camp automatically, so there is no camp ID to enter.

items.label: Preset troop mix
items.description: Auto Beri totals repeated troop slots across the selected preset’s waves and courtyard, then replenishes one underrepresented type at a time.

items.label: Food-only transfers
items.description: Only Food-fed preset troops can transfer; unsupported units or unresolved troop families pause with a reason.

items.label: Partial donor stock
items.description: When the donor has some of the needed troop type, Auto Beri sends that smaller amount; with none, it waits instead of sending another type.

items.label: Pending transfer
items.description: Auto Beri waits for each shipment to arrive and refreshes camp stock before recalculating the preset mix.

items.label: Check interval
items.description: Set how often Auto Beri refreshes free transfer capacity and both castle inventories.
items.recommendation: Keep the usual 30-second interval.

items.label: Minimum free capacity
items.description: Begin transfers only when reported free capacity reaches this threshold; an individual proportional shipment can be smaller.
items.recommendation: Use the smallest free-capacity threshold that suits your usual transfer pace.

items.label: Use troop transport time skips
items.description: Apply the selected skip to a confirmed transfer while it is still travelling.
items.recommendation: Off unless faster camp resupply is worth the saved skip items.

items.label: Troop transport skip
items.description: Choose the duration of the item used when transport skipping is on.
items.recommendation: Reserve longer skips for other tasks if you need them.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Beri set proportional troop transfers settings
image.caption: A fictional 2:1 preset mix, camp stock, free capacity, and one partial single-type shipment; values are examples, not saved defaults.

items.label: Only run with a Gallantry booster
items.description: Require an active Gallantry booster before transfers, tool purchases, camp setup, tower attacks, or construction proceed.
items.recommendation: On if you want every Auto Beri lane gated by the booster.

items.label: Attack preset loadout
items.description: Review the selected preset's waves, troops, and tools before enabling attacks.
items.recommendation: Keep enough of each selected troop and tool at the donor and camp for your normal attack pace.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Beri set tower attack readiness settings
image.caption: Booster gate status and preset loadout, with no implied live booster or customer data.

items.label: Scaling ladders minimum
items.description: Replenish this many stationed ladders at the camp using eligible coin offers; 0 leaves them unmanaged.
items.recommendation: Match the number your usual preset and attack pace need.

items.label: Battering rams minimum
items.description: Replenish this many stationed rams under the same rule.
items.recommendation: Match your usual preset's use.

items.label: Mantlets minimum
items.description: Replenish this many stationed mantlets under the same rule.
items.recommendation: Match your usual preset's use.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Beri maintain camp tools settings
image.caption: The three tool minimums and a clearly fictional camp inventory.

items.label: Auto Beri Builder lane
items.description: Build or upgrade an exact camp target using confirmed returned loot, without transporting resources from another kingdom.
items.recommendation: Off until you have reviewed the target and spending permissions.

items.label: Stable target
items.description: Choose the desired Faction Stable level from 1 through 5 for the built-in target.
items.recommendation: Choose the level your current event resources can support.

items.label: Optional custom camp target
items.description: Capture, preview, save, and activate a layout only if you want it to replace the built-in target.
items.recommendation: Keep the built-in target unless you have inspected a custom layout.

items.label: Use construction time skips
items.description: Advance a confirmed build timer while keeping the selected skip reserves.
items.recommendation: Off unless faster construction is worth those items.

items.label: Allow premium costs
items.description: Permit eligible construction steps that spend premium currency.
items.recommendation: Off unless you intentionally want premium construction.

items.label: Allow demolition
items.description: Permit exact-target cleanup of unmanaged buildings that cannot be moved or stored.
items.recommendation: Off unless you have reviewed the target's removals.

items.label: Camp resource reserves
items.description: Keep the chosen amounts of Berimond wood and stone unavailable to the builder.
items.recommendation: Reserve what you need for other camp work.

items.label: Construction time-skip reserves
items.description: Keep the chosen number of each skip item unavailable to the builder.
items.recommendation: Reserve what you need for other activities.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Beri choose optional camp construction settings
image.caption: Built-in target, stable target, construction permissions, and reserve groups.

items.label: Save settings
items.description: Save the preset, donor, transfer pacing, attack limits, tools, and optional build choices before enabling the automation.

items.label: Automation switch
items.description: Turn on Auto Beri World from its Automation card after confirming your camp, donor troops, preset, and optional spending settings.
items.recommendation: On after setup.

items.label: Calendar
items.description: Leave the schedule off for continuous operation, or set your usual hours and save the schedule if you need a time window.
items.recommendation: Off for ongoing event operation.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Beri save and enable settings
image.caption: Saved setup checklist, switch, and optional schedule, without showing a live account.
